versionChangeAfterRuntime: The release updates version metadata after the approved gameplay candidate.

runtime.recipes: Both ingredient orders produced the expected stored identities on the lawn. Both gameplay models were visible.
runtime.frostburnWood: A pea became a Snow Pea that chilled the target. A Snow Pea became a marked Polar shot with base damage 40. A native Torchwood Fireball became a regular Pea. Extreme damage was 10, 20 and 10 on the first sampled hits.
runtime.doomPult: The target retained 10,000 HP in the sampled flight. The first land hit dealt 900 HP, created one ember crater and applied normal ember. The next hit on the same crater dealt 50 HP. A water landing dealt 50 HP and created no crater. Extreme difficulty halves the base damage.
runtime.melonPot: A launched Doom Melon carried the -1800 Melon Pot support field.
runtime.restoration: Both runs restored the preceding DLL and verified matching profile and DP-3 state. Both game processes shut down normally.

test: Approved for the main runtime cases.
limits: The Melon Pot radius rule was reviewed. The sampled tiles and overlapping projectile flights could not isolate the radius difference in-game.
Existing plant, projectile and portrait resources supply the presentation. The game test covered active plant views.
The focused gameplay checks covered temporary Day and Pool boards. Almanac, audio and save/load were outside that scope.
